intuition: To land on a step, pay its cost after reaching one of the previous two steps; the top itself is free.

brute_force.approach: Recursively try one-step and two-step moves from each starting position.

optimal.approach: Keep the minimum costs to reach the two previous indices and roll them forward.

edge_cases: Either of the first two steps may be chosen without paying for the other.
The destination is beyond the last indexed stair, so its cost is not charged.
